state.product: The Daily Consensus: restore the owner's market research platform, originally launched in 2022; combine price/volume, technical context, options, source-linked news and attributed research into a coherent daily view.
userRequirements: Rebuild the existing product with current AI and the same data sources
All data must be real and attributed, no fictional accuracy or financial guarantees
Accessible keyboard controls and responsive mobile navigation
Missing feeds, stale quotes and partial options coverage must be explicit
state.platform: Existing React 18/CSS dashboard and separately recovered Next.js/React deployment; browser first, desktop and phone. Keep React components; server-only financial credentials and AI calls.

verifiedSourceState.market: Polygon adapter documented; entitlement tests pending
verifiedSourceState.news: Polygon news, issuer/primary sources and own Substack archive
verifiedSourceState.options: Polygon snapshot adapter documented; entitlement tests pending
verifiedSourceState.professional: Own attributed research archive; no verified external analyst feed
verifiedSourceState.darkpool: No original implemented feed recovered yet
verifiedSourceState.AI: TypeSafe for narrow typed classification; text synthesis only over verified evidence

state.experience: A calm, editorial-quality financial research desk. Make a morning read easy while retaining a serious analytical workspace. Users should see what moved, what evidence supports it, what contradicts it and which source is missing. No decorative charts or fake trading signals.

layout.instructions: Choose the primary desktop layout that best supports the product and constraints in state.

criteria.research_desk: Slim sidebar, main daily brief and chart, right context rail for source coverage and watchlist; mobile becomes single column with accessible menu.
criteria.market_terminal: Dense grid of resizable widgets and multiple price charts, with tabbed data panels.
criteria.editorial_feed: Top navigation with a single news/research feed and optional full-width detail pages.
criteria.expand_candidates: None of these layouts fits the constraints; request broader candidates.

hierarchy.instructions: Choose the first-screen content hierarchy for this market research product; do not invent unavailable data.

criteria.evidence_first: Source/freshness indicator, daily market brief, selected instrument chart and observations, supporting news/research, then deeper analysis.
criteria.ticker_first: Ticker search, large price chart and quote summary, then technical/options context and news.
criteria.news_first: Latest attributed research stories, then market metrics, search and technical details.
criteria.expand_candidates: None of these hierarchies adequately serves the user.

density.instructions: Choose content density for a daily research product that must work for new and experienced market readers on both desktop and phones.

criteria.comfortable_with_detail: Readable summary cards and generous 16-24px spacing; dense sortable tables only in dedicated analytical sections.
criteria.compact_all: Compact 8-12px spacing throughout, dense tables and terse abbreviations.
criteria.spacious_all: Very large feature cards and typography, with only a few observations per page.

presentation.instructions: Choose a cohesive visual direction using or evolving the existing token system. Light and dark mode and accessible contrasts are mandatory.

criteria.ink_editorial: Warm off-white/light paper, navy ink, restrained blue accent and serif display headings; dark theme in navy/charcoal; sans body and tabular numbers.
criteria.navy_research: Original navy surfaces, blue accent, modern sans type and restrained outlined modules; high-contrast light companion theme.
criteria.neutral_terminal: Neutral white/charcoal themes, monospaced financial typography and very restrained semantic colors.
